function.arguments: {"index": 3, "status": "acted", "resolution": "The treatment arm has a higher proportion of severe patients (95/253 ≈ 37.6%) compared to the control arm (21/459 ≈ 4.6%), while severe patients have lower response rates. This creates confounding: the raw difference in response rates (treatment - control = -0.0869) suggests treatment harms, but this is likely due to severity imbalance. To get the true treatment effect, we must adjust for severity. We computed the difference in response rates stratified by severity, then standardized it using the overall severity distribution as weights. This gives a corrected, unbiased estimate of the treatment effect."}
